newsitem.title: USA: Toastmaster to use Faultless name.
newsitem.headline: Toastmaster to use Faultless name.

text.p: Toastmaster Inc, positioning itself in the garment care industry, said Friday it reached an agreement with Faultless Starch/Bon Ami Co to use the Faultless name on clothes irons.

Toastmaster will unveil its new iron line at the 1997 International Housewares Exposition, which opens Sunday in Chicago. It will display seven new models, five with the Faultless brand and two Toastmaster branded units.
The appliance maker said its new products are expected to reach retail shelves in May.
